premise: The leaves turn red and gold and fall; Fox builds a huge pile and jumps in, and Hedgehog is already inside.
inspiration: The folk 'big jump' pattern (one, two, three, go!), turned into a hide-and-seek surprise: the pile was already somebody's bed.
lesson: Surprises are more fun when everyone joins in.
learning: Leaves change colour and fall in autumn

en-US.title: The Great Leaf Pile
en-US.text: The leaves on the old tree {tree:glow #FF9F43} turned red, and orange, and gold. {fox:face happy} [excited] Autumn! said Fox {fox:hop}. {canvas:wind 0.5 8s} Then the wind blew, {canvas:leaves 0.8 16s} and down they came, twirling and swirling all over the ground. Fox made a pile. A big pile. The BIGGEST pile! Acorn {acorn:hop x2} helped push in the little leaves. One… two… three… [excited] Fox jumped in! {fox:spin} {sfx:crunch} CRUNCH! Leaves flew everywhere. And from the very bottom of the pile came a sleepy voice. {fox:face surprised} {acorn:face surprised} [curious] Who's there? {hedgehog:live} It was Hedgehog! He yawned, curled into a ball, peeked out… and uncurled, covered in leaves. {acorn:face happy} {fox:face happy} [laughs] You look like a little leaf pile yourself! {acorn:wobble} giggled Acorn. {hedgehog:face happy} [happily] So they built it all again, and this time all three {fox:hop} {acorn:hop} jumped in together. {fox:hearts} {acorn:hearts}

es-ES.title: El gran montón de hojas
es-ES.text: Las hojas del viejo árbol {tree:glow #FF9F43} se volvieron rojas, y naranjas, y doradas. {fox:face happy} [excited] ¡Otoño!, dijo Zorro {fox:hop}. {canvas:wind 0.5 8s} Entonces sopló el viento, {canvas:leaves 0.8 16s} y las hojas bajaron dando vueltas y más vueltas por todo el suelo. Zorro hizo un montón. Un montón grande. ¡El montón MÁS GRANDE! Bellota {acorn:hop x2} le ayudó a meter las hojas pequeñas. Una… dos… tres… [excited] ¡Zorro saltó dentro! {fox:spin} {sfx:crunch} ¡CRUNCH! Las hojas volaron por todas partes. Y desde el fondo del montón se oyó una voz dormida. {fox:face surprised} {acorn:face surprised} [curious] ¿Quién anda ahí? {hedgehog:live} ¡Era Erizo! Bostezó, se hizo una bola, asomó la nariz… y se desenrolló, lleno de hojas. {acorn:face happy} {fox:face happy} [laughs] ¡Pareces un montoncito de hojas!, {acorn:wobble} se rio Bellota. {hedgehog:face happy} [happily] Así que lo volvieron a hacer entero, y esta vez {fox:hop} {acorn:hop} saltaron los tres a la vez. {fox:hearts} {acorn:hearts}

crunch.prompt: a small animal jumping into a big crunchy pile of dry autumn leaves
